text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ryan, who has been off her game 
lately, suggested that we go to a shrine.

I was certain she had come to pray to the 
gods to cure her condition, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: —Haa, haa... phew.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Alright. That's 10 round trips of stair 
training complete!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yes! So I thought I'd work up a sweat and 
get myself back in shape.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
—Ah. Could it be that... I didn't train 
hard enough...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, 10 more laps. I'm gonna go sweat a 
whole waterfall!

Since we came all the way to the shrine, I 
suggested offering a prayer before 
leaving.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's true. Since we're here, let's 
make a prayer!
(Clink—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Phew... That should do it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
The results of my daily discipline— I 
wonder if they will truly reach the gods.
choice_data_list:
I'm sure they're watching over me 
properly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
The results of my daily discipline— I 
wonder if they will truly reach the gods.
choice_data_list:
I'm sure they're watching over me 
properly, you know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: —Yes, that's right!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm all fired up! I'm gonna 
keep dashing up those stairs!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Whoooa! Muscle, muscle!

Whether due to the training or the prayers 
being answered, Mejiro Ryan seemed to have 
gotten back in top shape.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I hope that's the case...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
M-Maybe my training really wasn't enough! 
I'm gonna go run one more time...!
(*Click*...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: E-Eh? Why so suddenly!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Sigh. I can't run properly like this.

Unable to train to her satisfaction, 
Mejiro Ryan hung her head and headed home.
